units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:28">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:22">Lam. R. to II, 19</cite>.

Ber. 3ᵇ (ref. to Jud. VII, 19) אין ת׳ אלא שיש וכ׳ you cannot say middle watch, unless there is one before and one after (which proves that the night is divided into three watches); Yalk. Jud. 63.—Pl. תִּיכוֹנוֹת.

Ib. מאי תיכונה תיכונה שבת׳ tikhonah means here the middle of the middle watches, i.e. the end of the second and the beginning of the third of the four watches; v. תִּוֵּוךְ; Ber. l. c. אחת מן התיכונה שבת׳ (corr. acc.).
